info.description: Singleton: global on/off toggle + default commission rate. Rate is snapshotted onto each accrued commission at deposit time, so changing the value here NEVER retroactively re-computes existing commissions — it only affects deposits confirmed after the change.

enabled.description: Global kill switch. When false, NO new commissions accrue for anyone. Previously accrued commissions remain intact and visible.

defaultRatePercent.description: Default commission percentage applied to every qualifying deposit unless the affiliate has a per-affiliate override. Interpreted as a percent (5 = 5%).
